summary: First-round E2E of Vanguarda.IA. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed (auth, dashboard, clients CRUD, pieces incl. SSE streaming, bible ask with sources, campaigns sync/toggle/create, logs, alert rules, settings, admin users, Stripe checkout creation). Frontend: landing loads, admin login+dashboard KPIs, clientes list all 3 seeded, generator streams SSE text via GPT-5.4 Mini (327 chars content) and saves piece, bible ask returns streaming answer 'acolhedor, artesanal e sensorial' with source chip, campanhas has 7 sync buttons + ROAS visible, logs shows 'CTR abaixo do saudável' rule, settings has 4 tabs (Modelos de IA, Agência, Integrações, Usuários) with Meta Ads toggle in Integrações, planos R$ + Mensal toggle + 'Assinar Starter' redirects to real Stripe Checkout (checkout.stripe.com), avatar menu logout returns to /login, wrong password shows 'E-mail ou senha incorretos' in pt-BR. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: CORS is set with wildcard `CORS_ORIGINS=*` in .env but middleware hardcodes FRONTEND_URL + localhost:3000 (env var ignored) — intentional since credentials require explicit origins, but the .env variable is misleading. Consider removing CORS_ORIGINS from .env or wiring it in.
backend/server.py: `evaluate_alert_rules` runs full campaign scan on every /campaigns/{id}/sync call; fine for demo but O(rules*campaigns) — will need indexing/scoping if user has many campaigns.
backend/payments.py: `stripe.api_key` falls back to literal 'sk_test_emergent' if env unset — should hard-fail instead of using a bogus key.
Bible /biblia/ask uses simple word-overlap scoring with a fallback to first 3 docs when nothing matches; may leak unrelated documents as 'sources'.

Password reset email uses `INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL` + EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY — silently returns False if not configured; forgot-password will always show generic message even when email delivery is unavailable (this is correct behavior but hides operational failures).
seed_data_creation: Backend already seeds 3 clients, 6 campaigns, 3 bible docs, 1 alert rule on startup — verified present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints pass. Stripe test checkout URL redirects correctly to checkout.stripe.com. Full post-payment /payment/success round-trip with 4242 card was NOT completed (would require filling Stripe's own hosted page); if needed, add Playwright step to fill the Stripe page fields and validate PaymentResult page. Google OAuth button exists but requires real Google account, not tested. Claude Sonnet 4.6 model was not exercised in UI (only via model param validation); GPT-5.4 Mini streaming validated. Image generation button was not clicked (30-60s wait) — API path is /api/pieces/generate-image and code is straightforward.
